race.description: Celebrate Christmas At The Cairns Jockey Club Hcp (Bm55)
race.comment: MINNIE VEGAS (10) is nearing another win and has enough early pace to offset the wide draw and make all the running back to 950m. LOOMING ONE (1) was good late for third at Townsville, beaten a length and a half after interference, and now eases back. Can burst through late. NIVEN (5) resumes off a Townsville Mdn win as favourite, with Wiggins booked and a useful record around 950m, though race fitness is the obvious factor fresh. SHOWN THE DOOR (7) also returns and could land in a tricky spot from the inside pillar if Thomas isn't on top of his game. HOT COCOA (4) can feature second up from a spell.
